title: When Rerankers Work Together: Better and Faster Reranking without Joint Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.33844v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standalone reranker quality does not determine its value in a multistage RAG pipeline. We systematically study heterogeneous rerankers composed without joint training, spanning lexical, single-vector, late-interaction, and joint query-context scoring. Two lightweight semantic coarse scorers, Cache-Pointwise and Cache-Shapley, learn from passage relevance labels and share cacheable representations and linear-time singleton inference. Under matched candidates and budgets, we compare cascades with stage-removal references to measure evidence retention, repair and breakage, reader accuracy, and online pruning cost. On NoLiMa 32K with Gemma, inserting these scorers before CrossEncoder or Provence improves answer accuracy by 4.02-9.43 percentage points while accelerating online pruning by 1.57-1.88x relative to the corresponding reranker alone. translated_title: 当重排序器协同工作时：无需联合训练的更好更快的重排序
translated_abstract: 独立重排序器的质量并不能决定其在多阶段RAG（检索增强生成）流水线中的价值。我们系统地研究了无需联合训练即可组合的异构重排序器，涵盖词汇匹配、单向量、延迟交互以及联合查询-上下文评分等多种方法。我们提出了两种轻量级语义粗评分器——Cache-Pointwise和Cache-Shapley，它们从段落相关性标签中学习，共享可缓存的表示形式和线性时间的单例推理。在候选集合和预算匹配的条件下，我们将级联系统与移除特定阶段的参考系统进行比较，以衡量证据保留、修复与破坏、阅读器准确率以及在线剪枝成本。在使用Gemma模型的NoLiMa 32K数据集上，将这些评分器插入到CrossEncoder或Provence之前，可使答案准确率提高4.02-9.43个百分点，同时相对于单独使用相应重排序器，在线剪枝速度加快1.57-1.88倍。Cache-Pointwise通过倒数排名融合与ColBERTv2组合，可使准确率提高4.60个百分点。
tldr: 该研究提出两种无需联合训练的轻量级语义粗评分器，可与异构重排序器组合，在多阶段RAG流水线中显著提升答案准确率并加速在线剪枝。
en_tdlr: This work introduces lightweight semantic coarse scorers that compose heterogeneous rerankers without joint training, significantly improving answer accuracy by up to 9.43 percentage points while accelerating online pruning in multistage RAG pipelines.
